title: Answer: experience is derived, what a coherent generative model is like

statements.text: Experience is not basic. It is what it is like to be the functioning of a probabilistic generative model of an embodied agent, and only when that model is coherent in space, time and cause.

sources.quote: Basic phenomenal consciousness is what it is like to be the functioning of a probabilistic generative model for the sensorium of an embodied–embedded agent.
